name: Tiko Sum
subtitle: Math that talks, for kids
promotional_text: A calm, ad-free math app that speaks every number and never says "wrong". The answer is always a choice — tap it or say it out loud.
description:
Tiko Sum is a friendly talking math app for children — and it is not a calculator: it never shows the result. Every key your child presses is spoken aloud ("three… plus… five…"), and the answer is always a choice between three big tiles. Pick the right one and the screen celebrates; pick another and Sum simply says the formula again — no buzzer, no red cross, no pressure.

- A big speaking keypad: every number and symbol is read aloud in your language
- The answer is a choice: three tiles, one right, two clever look-alikes
- Paths: playful rows of five sums, from first counting to times tables and fair shares
- Answer by voice: turn it on and your child can just say the number (off by default, nothing is ever recorded)
- Every path is editable and parents can build their own
- Speaks and counts in English, Dutch, French, Spanish, German and Maltese — including proper number words like "eenentwintig" and "quatre-vingt-onze"
- Works offline after first use; no ads, no scores, no streaks
- Child mode keeps the screen focused and distraction-free

Tiko Sum is part of Tiko, a child-first universe of small, focused communication and learning tools.
release_notes:
